scope: Complete pending-tool-result handoff when trusted instructions or session configuration change.

diagnosis.confirmedBehavior: The prior pending-session guard rejected complete matching result batches when trusted instructions changed, leaving subsequent continuations subject to the same 409.
diagnosis.originalIncidentLimit: The exact changed field in the user's earlier request was unavailable. The controlled probe reproduced the instruction-change path, not every possible cause of a 409.
diagnosis.correction: Validate the complete result batch and unchanged non-instruction history, confirm old-session cleanup and same-generation SDK readiness, then carry completed results into a replacement session as history without submitting the old result RPCs.
diagnosis.failureBoundary: Missing, duplicate, mismatched or rewritten history is rejected before retirement. Failed cleanup, readiness, cancellation or replacement keeps the family unavailable rather than implicitly retrying completed work.

scopedUnitIntegrationAndOfflineTui.note: The live-probe standalone-line prompt clarification followed this run; production bridge code did not change. The final probe was separately rerun below.

stabilityRuntime.verificationSource: Use that run's frozen source; later test-harness edits changed the implementation manifest.

preservedInitialLiveRun.failures: Sonnet and Haiku returned the correct sample inline. The strict terminal marker oracle required a standalone line, but the initial prompt did not request it; their follow-up turns were not run.
preservedInitialLiveRun.correction: Versioned the focused probe prompts to request the existing oracle's standalone-line format, then reran all six models. No production prompt/output rewriting or historical regrading.

failures.observedCause: Explicit upstream contentFilterTriggered=true and finishReason=content_filter; eight cases failed before any tool call, and S07 failed during ordinary result continuation.
failures.historicalComparison: The earlier v4 report on implementation 68f92d74 also recorded 57/66 with nine Opus filter failures. This is a separate v5 run, not a regrade or proof of the provider's internal cause.

releaseVerification.reason: The user conditioned commit/push on finding no problems. The complete stability matrix retains nine upstream-filter failures, so commit and push were withheld rather than treating those failures as passes.

limitations: The focused six-case run and the later full release matrices are independent results. The 57/66 stability run does not meet the earlier 95% target; no scores were combined or failures waived.
Preserving completed IDs and avoiding duplicate result RPCs does not prevent a model from proposing the same semantic operation under a new call ID.

Source edits apply only after a normal Codex/bridge exit and relaunch; the active user bridge was not modified. Resume was verified in isolated TUI cases, not by taking over the user's original conversation.
Accelerated repeated handoffs and full scenario matrices do not certify multi-hour reliability or future upstream availability.
